data_fields.name: sell_price_one_floor
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 (raw value used when the ratio rounds to 0)

data_fields.name: net_slot_need
data_fields.donor_constant: max(0, partner item count minus my item count)

best_idea: A trade where an item that leaves an inventory drops out of the offer and clears both accepts, and settlement checks money, ownership and slots before anything moves.
decision_why: Keep reference offers, invalidation on leave, the net slot check and the shared trade lock; do not pre-remove money (check at settle instead, so there is no refund path); fix the failure path that the donor leaves half-applied.
acceptance: A player moves an offered item to another slot; it disappears from both offers and both accepts clear. A server test asserts that a settle that fails on the second side's item leaves both accounts' money and items unchanged.
